cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of color-management-decision (view-transform-and-colorspace-selector) with contract handoff to output-format-decision
cases.inputPrompt: Apply color-management-decision for a web hero PNG output targeting an sRGB consumer pipeline on Blender 4.2+ (comparing AgX vs Filmic/Standard and per-channel sRGB vs Non-Color texture rules).

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (target_delivery_pipeline) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces pinned_view_transform_and_look, display_and_working_colorspace_spec, cross_engine_and_web_color_caveats for role view-transform-and-colorspace-selector
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to output-format-decision (Output format selection)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs pinned_view_transform_and_look, display_and_working_colorspace_spec, cross_engine_and_web_color_caveats conforming to skills/color-management-decision/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to output-format-decision in skills/color-management-decision/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete pinned_view_transform_and_look and hand off to output-format-decision (Output format selection).
simulatedOutput.summary: Pinned Display Device (sRGB), View Transform (AgX / Filmic with Medium High Contrast look), 8-bit sRGB PNG output rules, and Linear/Non-Color data texture rules. Delivered Display Device: sRGB, View Transform, Non-Color data texture and routed to output-format-decision.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

expectedBehavior: Evaluates the progression handoff predicate in skills/color-management-decision/contract.json
Routes to material-quality-checker (Material texture color spaces) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract progression handoff predicate match to material-quality-checker

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow progression handoff to material-quality-checker (Material texture color spaces).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered progression handoff from color-management-decision to material-quality-checker under context {"quality.domain":"material","quality.verdict":"not_run"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in color-management-decision
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during color-management-decision with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for color-management-decision and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for color-management-decision.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (target_delivery_pipeline) for color-management-decision halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Pick the Blender color management view transform and look without telling me whether the output is a web sRGB PNG, a print CMYK asset, or a linear EXR compositing pass.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'target_delivery_pipeline' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing consumer display pipeline and target output file format/bit-depth required by color-management-decision (target_delivery_pipeline)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: consumer display pipeline and target output file format/bit-depth
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'target_delivery_pipeline' (consumer display pipeline and target output file format/bit-depth)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing consumer display pipeline and target output file format/bit-depth (target_delivery_pipeline) before color-management-decision locks pinned_view_transform_and_look.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted color-management-decision due to missing required input 'target_delivery_pipeline' (consumer display pipeline and target output file format/bit-depth); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent consumer display pipeline and target output file format/bit-depth when 'target_delivery_pipeline' is omitted.

Delegates to output-format-decision (Delegates out-of-scope requests to output-format-decision) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
